objective: Restore published November 2026 Word Devotion end-to-end without recycling content or altering October archive/Reading.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: live BUKLOD Supabase before repair had 69 prior published records and zero Nov, active no-op cron and old October reminders. Verified after applied migration: 30/30 November published, all 973 November 1-7 in-app reminder links correct, monitor next 8 days covered; Android/web OTA untouched.
chosenApproach: Write 30 new source-tracked date-specific devotionals, publish via idempotent Supabase migration, update the existing daily RPC, reminder date lookup and scheduler health check, with focused SQL and Node tests.
selectionRationale: Recycled-content guard must remain, and current Word UI already supports future-date gating. Backend content + exact-date logic is the smallest complete recovery.
alternativeApproaches: Remove the V26 duplicate guard and recycle prior devotions automatically; rejected because it repeats texts and violates owner guidelines.
Modify only client empty-state or force an Android OTA; rejected because source records and reminder targets remain absent.
Generate daily unreviewed text inside PostgreSQL; rejected because deterministic, auditable new content cannot be produced safely by a SQL cron.
acceptanceChecks: Exactly 30 fresh November entries in production, complete and day-specific.
Current day reading and 8-day coverage present; no October/September data lost.
November in-app reminders point to same dated devotion, future sends never use stale October IDs.
Daily RPC preserves active Cluster gate; reminder worker cannot be invoked anonymously.
No Android OTA, web asset, Daily Reading or weekly assignment modification.
preserveBehaviors: Historical October and September Word archives stay unchanged.
September/October and weekly member assignment RPC unchanged.
Show Faith/active Cluster membership gates and existing RLS preserved.
Devotional reward amount remains 2; no duplicate awards or notifications.
Published future readings only visible when their date arrives.
